definitions.text_mt: Qata' b'snienu
Qarraq b'xi ħadd, ingannah

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb gidem lit-tifel fuq siequ.
usage_examples.en: The dog bit the boy on his foot.

usage_examples.mt: Dak il-bejjiegħ gidem lix-xerrejja bil-prezzijiet għoljin.
usage_examples.en: That seller swindled the buyers with the high prices.

definitions.text_mt: Frieħ il-mogħża, ta' ftit xhur

usage_examples.mt: Il-gidi beda jiġri wara ommu fil-mergħa.
usage_examples.en: The kid started running after its mother in the field.

usage_examples.mt: Rajna gidi abjad żgħir ħdejn il-laringħa.
usage_examples.en: We saw a small white kid near the enclosure.

definitions.text_mt: Kostellazzjoni taż-Żodijaku bejn is-Saġittarju u l-Akwarju
Is-sinjal taż-Żodijaku ta' min imwieled mit-22 ta' Diċembru sad-19 ta' Jannar

usage_examples.mt: Il-kostellazzjoni ta' Gidi l-Kbir tidher ċara fix-xitwa.
usage_examples.en: The constellation of Capricorn is clearly visible in winter.

usage_examples.mt: Jien imwieled f'Jannar, allura jien Gidi l-Kbir.
usage_examples.en: I was born in January, so I am Capricorn.

definitions.text_mt: Mammiferu primat ta' denbu twil, ġeneralment ta' daqs żgħir

usage_examples.mt: Dak iz-zoo għandu gidmejmun kbir li jixbah lill-bniedem.
usage_examples.en: That zoo has a large monkey that resembles a human.

definitions.text_mt: Mammiferu karnivoru ta' geddumu bil-ponot, widnejh wieqfa u denbu oħxon

usage_examples.mt: Rajna gilpa tiġri fil-kampanja warajhom it-tiġieġ.
usage_examples.en: We saw a fox running in the countryside after the chickens.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gilpa hi annimal għaqli u mgħarref.
usage_examples.en: The fox is a clever and cunning animal.

definitions.text_en: Equatorial Guinea (a country in Central Africa Official name: Ir-Repubblika tal-Ginea Ekwatorjali).
definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali, magħruf uffiċjalment bħala Ir-Repubblika tal-Ginea Ekwatorjali

usage_examples.mt: Il-Ginea Ekwatorjali hi pajjiż żgħir fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
usage_examples.en: Equatorial Guinea is a small country in West Africa.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-Repubblika tal-Ginea Ekwatorjali kisbet l-indipendenza fl-1968.
usage_examples.en: The Republic of Equatorial Guinea gained independence in 1968.

definitions.text_en: Sty, pigsty (an enclosure where pigs are kept)
definitions.text_mt: Maqjel magħluq għall-ħnieżer

definitions.text_en: Hutch (an enclosure where rabbits are kept)
definitions.text_mt: Gaġġa jew maqjel żgħir għall-fniek
Dar fqira u mhux miżmuma tajjeb, mhix komda

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi naddaf il-girbeġ wara li ħareġ il-ħnieżer.
usage_examples.en: The farmer cleaned the pigsty after letting the pigs out.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fenek inżamm f'girbeġ żgħir u nadif.
usage_examples.en: The rabbit was kept in a small, clean hutch.

definitions.text_mt: Ġarraf il-wiċċ b'dwiefer jew b'xi ħaġa ggruma
Serq b'qerq jew b'ingann

usage_examples.mt: Il-qattus giref il-bieb biex jidħol ġewwa.
usage_examples.en: The cat scratched the door to get inside.

usage_examples.mt: Dak in-negozjant giref il-flus tal-klijenti tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: That businessman swindled his clients' money.

definitions.text_mt: Ġellied professjonali fl-imperi tar-Rumani tal-qedem

usage_examples.mt: Il-gladjaturi kienu jiġġieldu fl-arena għad-divertiment tal-pubbliku.
usage_examples.en: The gladiators used to fight in the arena for the public's entertainment.

usage_examples.mt: Spartacus kien l-aktar gladjatur famuż fl-istorja Rumana.
usage_examples.en: Spartacus was the most famous gladiator in Roman history.

definitions.text_mt: Fama kbira, unur u tifħir kbir

usage_examples.mt: Is-suldat irċieva glorja kbira wara l-battalja.
usage_examples.en: The soldier received great glory after the battle.

usage_examples.mt: Il-mużika ta' Vivaldi ġġib glorja lill-belt ta' Venezja.
usage_examples.en: Vivaldi's music brings glory to the city of Venice.

definitions.text_mt: Mimli glorja, denn ta' tifħir kbir

usage_examples.mt: Kien mument glorjuż għat-tim meta ġab it-tazza d-dar.
usage_examples.en: It was a glorious moment for the team when they brought the cup home.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vista mill-quċċata tal-muntanja kienet glorjuża.
usage_examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was glorious.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-glottis jew mal-ħoss li jagħmlu l-kordi vokali

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħoss glottali hu importanti fil-lingwa Maltija.
usage_examples.en: The glottal sound is important in the Maltese language.

definitions.text_mt: Zokkor sempliċi li jinsab fil-frott, fl-għasel u fid-demm tal-bnedmin

usage_examples.mt: Il-glukows huwa sors ewlieni ta' enerġija għall-ġisem.
usage_examples.en: Glucose is a main source of energy for the body.

usage_examples.mt: It-tobba jkejlu l-livell tal-glukows fid-demm.
usage_examples.en: Doctors measure the glucose level in the blood.

definitions.text_mt: Zokkor sempliċi li jinsab fil-frott, fl-għasel u fid-demm tal-bnedmin

usage_examples.mt: Il-glukożju jinstab b'mod naturali fil-frott u fl-għasel.
usage_examples.en: Glucose is found naturally in fruit and honey.

usage_examples.mt: Pazjenti bid-dijabete għandhom jimmonitorjaw il-glukożju tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: Diabetic patients should monitor their glucose.

definitions.text_en: To enjoy, to take pleasure in
definitions.text_mt: Ħass pjaċir bil-kbir b'xi ħaġa, tgħaxxaq b'xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: In-nies godew bil-kunċert ta' billejl.
usage_examples.en: The people enjoyed last night's concert.

usage_examples.mt: Igawdu l-ħajja meta jkunu mal-familja.
usage_examples.en: They enjoy life when they are with family.

definitions.text_mt: Għamla arkajka ta' gozz: munzell jew borġ ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma 'gods' hi għamla arkajka ta' 'gozz'.
usage_examples.en: The word 'gods' is an archaic form of 'gozz'.

definitions.text_mt: Sustanza reżinuża li toħroġ minn xi pjanti u twebbes fl-arja
Sustanza elastika li tinkiseb mil-lattiċe tas-siġra tal-gomma
Għodda tal-gomma li tħassar il-marki tal-lapes u tal-linka

usage_examples.mt: Il-gomma tal-lapes spiċċat, għandi bżonn waħda ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The pencil eraser ran out, I need a new one.

usage_examples.mt: Is-siġra tal-gomma tipproduċi lattiċe għall-gomma naturali.
usage_examples.en: The rubber tree produces latex for natural rubber.

usage_examples.mt: Uża l-gomma biex tħassar dak iż-żball.
usage_examples.en: Use the eraser to delete that mistake.

definitions.text_mt: Li fih il-gomma, li huwa magħmul mill-gomma, jew li jixbah il-gomma

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħelu kien gommuż u twaħħal.
usage_examples.en: The candy was gummy and sticky.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sustanza gommuża ma tħallietx tixxarrab.
usage_examples.en: The gummy substance did not let itself get soaked.

definitions.text_mt: Ħuta kbira tal-familta' Sciaenidae, Argyrosomus regius
Ħuta tat-tip Umbrina cirrosa, ta' kulur fiddieni
Ħuta tat-tip Sciaena umbra, ta' kulur skur

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjied qabad gorbell kbir ħdejn il-kosta.
usage_examples.en: The fisherman caught a large meagre near the coast.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gorbell huwa ħuta apprezzata ħafna fil-kċina Maltija.
usage_examples.en: The meagre is a highly appreciated fish in Maltese cuisine.

definitions.text_en: Sty, pigsty (an enclosure where pigs are kept)
definitions.text_mt: Maqjel magħluq għall-ħnieżer

definitions.text_en: Hutch (an enclosure where rabbits are kept)
definitions.text_mt: Gaġġa jew maqjel żgħir għall-fniek
Dar fqira u mhux miżmuma tajjeb, mhix komda

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħnieżer inżammu fil-gorboġ matul il-lejl.
usage_examples.en: The pigs were kept in the sty during the night.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fenek jaħrab mill-gorboġ jekk ma jingħalaqx tajjeb.
usage_examples.en: The rabbit escapes from the hutch if it is not closed properly.

usage_examples.mt: Kien jgħix f'gorboġ żgħir u skur.
usage_examples.en: He used to live in a small, dark hovel.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-gvern jew mal-amministrazzjoni pubblika

usage_examples.mt: Id-deċiżjoni governattiva ġiet ippubblikata llum fil-gazzetta.
usage_examples.en: The governmental decision was published today in the gazette.

usage_examples.mt: Il-politika governattiva nbidlet wara l-elezzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The governmental policy changed after the election.

definitions.text_mt: Munzell ta' affarijiet imqiegħda fuq xulxin

usage_examples.mt: Ġabar gozz kotob fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: He gathered a pile of books on the table.

usage_examples.mt: Hemm gozz ġebel fil-bitħa li għandna nneħħu.
usage_examples.en: There is a heap of stones in the yard that we need to remove.

definitions.text_mt: Unitá tal-kejl ta' angolu, indikata bis-simbolu °
Unitá tal-kejl tat-temperatura

usage_examples.mt: Angolu rett għandu 90 grad.
usage_examples.en: A right angle has 90 degrees.

usage_examples.mt: It-temperatura llum hi 35 grad Celsius.
usage_examples.en: The temperature today is 35 degrees Celsius.

definitions.text_mt: Għamara b'kexxex għall-ħażna ta' ħwejjeġ u affarijiet oħra

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ nodfa fil-gradenza.
usage_examples.en: I put the clean clothes in the chest of drawers.

usage_examples.mt: Il-gradenza tal-kamra kienet magħmula mill-injam skur.
usage_examples.en: The bedroom chest of drawers was made of dark wood.

definitions.text_en: Gram (a unit of mass equal to one-thousandth of a kilogram Symbol: g)
definitions.text_mt: Unitá tal-kejl tal-piż, elf wilda minn kilogramm

usage_examples.mt: Il-pakkett jiżen mitejn gramm.
usage_examples.en: The packet weighs two hundred grams.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi bżonn 500 gramm ta' dqiq għar-ricetta.
usage_examples.en: I need 500 grams of flour for the recipe.
